invalidation: Re-review before enabling arbitrary schemas, elicitation, URL/host/path policy, network transports, resources, remote references, new SDK APIs, or changing dependencies. This is not a claim that fast-uri 3.1.0 is patched or vulnerability-free.
overrideDisposition: npm overrides cannot replace code embedded inside published SDK bundles; no SDK fork or byte patch is permitted.
policy: Exact published versions and integrity remain unchanged; no lifecycle execution, native addon, optional download, dependency patch, or new authority. The correction requires STOP for an applicable high-severity issue; reviewed exploitation preconditions are absent in this frozen surface.

reachability.attackerInputs: Closed tool arguments are Base64/digests and never schemas or URI policy inputs. Metadata and requested resource URIs are not dereferenced, normalized, routed, or used for authority.
reachability.productionRuntime: The MemoryOS worker closure does not import the MCP SDK or fast-uri. It uses Zod for closed argument admission and authoritative MemoryOS artifact parsers.
reachability.provider: SDK Node shim selects a lazy AjvJsonSchemaValidator. Low-level Server uses its getValidator only for elicitation form responses. MO-1304 neither sends server requests nor enables elicitation and registers low-level handlers.
reachability.tests: tests/security.test.mjs reproduces vulnerable normalization, then instruments getValidator and the AJV getter to throw on use; all six tools, discovery, listing, URI metadata, rejected URI arguments, resource requests, and subscription inputs complete without provider invocation. Parent and worker network/shell attempts are trapped.
